description: Execute commands from a file in the current shell.

name: bind
description: Set Readline key bindings and variables.

name: break

name: caller
description: Return the context of the current subroutine call.

name: command
description: Execute a simple command or display information about commands.

name: compgen
description: Display possible completions depending on the options.

name: complete
description: Specify how arguments are to be completed by Readline.

description: Resume for, while, or until loops.

description: Write arguments to the standard output.

description: Execute arguments as a shell command.
